'''Teligi Road''' was a road in the [[Worker sector]] of [[New Apsolon (city)|New Apsolon]]. [[Irini]] had been captured by [[Absolutes|the Absolutes]] on this road. After the [[Revolution on Apsolon|revolution]] a [[Workers memorials|memorial]] was placed on the same spot.
